Dear Madam
I am much obliged for the loan of these two books. I have the [Queens of England](/organisation/157)but not the Queens of Scotland, and the little book about Northamptonshire told me just what I wanted[^3]
With many thanks

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^3]: Agnes Strickland, Lives of the Queens of England From the Norman Conquest 12 vols (London: Colburn 1840-8); Agnes Strickland, Lives of the Queens of Scotland and English Princesses 8 vols (Edinburgh: Blackwood 1850-9).
